title: Solid Axle Suspension - Air Spring
text: Air spring solid axle suspension, 10 inputs, 6 outputs, {Toe angle vs steering angle slope, ToeStrgSlp} sets Toe angle steering slope; {Model type} sets the air suspension model, {Number of axles, NumAxl}, {Number of wheels by axle, NumWhlsByAxl} sets the number of wheels per axle, {Steered axle enable by axle, StrgEnByAxl} sets the boolean vector to enable axle steering, {Axle and wheels lumped principal moment of inertia about longitudinal axis, AxlIxx} sets the principal moment of inertia about longitudinal, {Axle and wheels lumped mass, AxlM}, {Track hardpoint coordinates relative to axle center, TrackCoords} sets the track hardpoint coordinates, {Suspension hardpoint coordinates relative to axle center, SuspCoords} sets the suspension hardpoint coordinates, {Wheel and axle interface compliance constant, KzWhlAxl}, {Wheel and axle interface compliance preload, F0zWhlAxl}, {Wheel and axle interface damping constant, CzWhlAxl [Ns/m]}, {Air suspension spring preload, F0z}, {Air suspension shock damping constant, Cz}, {Air spring effective area, EffctArea}, {Air spring volume in design position, VolDgnPos}, {Air spring isentropic exponent, IstpExp}, {Air spring outer diameter, OuterDiam}, {Air spring piston diameter, PistDiam}, {Air suspension maximum height, Hmax}, {Toe angle at steering center, Toe}, {Roll steer vs suspension height slope, RollStrgSlp} sets the steer angle suspension slope, {Caster angle at steering center, Caster}, {Caster angle vs suspension height slope, CasterHslp} sets the caster angle versus suspension height, {Caster angle vs steering angle slope, CasterStrgSlp} sets the caster angle versus steering angle slope, {Camber angle at steering center, Camber}, {Camber angle vs suspension height slope, CamberHslp} sets the camber angle versus suspension height, {Camber angle vs steering angle slope, CamberStrgSlp} sets the camber angle versus steering angle slope, {Suspension height vs steering angle slope, StrgHgtSlp} sets the suspension height versus steering angle, {Axle breakpoints, f_susp_axl_bp} sets the breakpoints, {Vertical axis suspension height breakpoints, f_susp_dz_bp} sets the breakpoints 1 -by, {Vertical axis air suspension pressure breakpoints, f_susp_press_bp} sets the vertical axis air suspension pressure breakpoints, {Vertical air axis suspension force and moment responses, f_susp_fmz} sets the output array zeros, {Air suspension shock damping constant, c_airSusp} sets the air suspension shock damping, {Suspension geometry responses, f_susp_geom} sets the suspension geometry responses zeros and {Steering angle breakpoints, f_susp_strgdelta_bp} sets the steering angle breakpoints 1 -by. Values come from the instance.
